annotations.title: Link to a ranked curator list

description: Builds a Curator Match link for a game developer who wants Steam curators to send review keys to. Use it when a developer asks which curators to contact for their game, wants an outreach or key list, or is planning a launch or Next Fest. Send one to five games similar to theirs, by name or app id. The link opens Curator Match with those games filled in: the ranked curators who covered them, their warning signs and the send list for Curator Connect. Also returns what the free and paid plans include. Creates nothing and needs no account.

games.description: One to five Steam games similar to the developer's game: names as the store shows them ("Hades"), app ids ("1145360") or store links.
